name: Xerte Online Toolkits
summary: Free, open-source browser-based suite for building accessible interactive learning objects and simple websites, used by universities, colleges and schools.

value: Learning objects deployed through Moodle or Blackboard
Template page types for non-technical authors
JavaScript and CSS access for developers
Assistants for text, tasks and image search (some AI-based)

researchTasks: Added from Jim's authoring tools expansion workbook (research snapshot 21 Nov 2026); every recorded fact re-checked against the vendor's own pages on 21 Nov 2026.

dataGaps.note: No SCORM, xAPI or LTI support named on the pages read.
Strong accessibility claim; no WCAG conformance statement found.
Wiki says some Assistant features use AI; providers not named.
